capabilities: Render a note's headings as a draggable, color-coded mind map
Edit each heading's section in an editor tab or built-in pane
Reorder, promote, add and delete nodes by dragging or keyboard
Embed other notes as expandable read-only outline nodes
Restore collapsed nodes, selection, scroll and zoom per note
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; installable today via BRAT or manually. Documented limits: no full undo/redo integration, and tables and embedded images appear as plain Markdown in the built-in pane.
intentEvidence: It started as a fork of Heading Mindmap by JhihJian (MIT licensed), which is no longer maintained.
motivation: The original Heading Mindmap plugin by JhihJian is no longer maintained, so the author forked it and revamped it.
problem: Obsidian has no way to see and rearrange a note's heading outline as a visual, interactive mind map.

relations.evidence: It started as a fork of Heading Mindmap by JhihJian (MIT licensed)
Install the BRAT community plugin and turn it on.

summary: Mind map view that turns a note's headings into draggable, color-coded nodes and edits each section in an editor beside the map.
